answer: Each identity takes one ledge in the harbor, posting a 70-credit bond. Every job writes a fable split in two: the agent keeps one half, the harbor the other. Rewards pay only if the halves match; a mismatch or reused half burns the bond. Tallies ride a rising ladder: first 20, k-th 20+5(k-1). 1,000 fakes pay 2,517,500, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Borrowed halves cannot forge the harbor half. One honest agent pays 20 once, keeps its share.
